content: Standard Vulkan vertex/index buffer upload: allocate a host-visible+host-coherent staging buffer, memcpy vertex/index data into it, then vkCmdCopyBuffer to a device-local (VK_MEMORY_PROPERTY_DEVICE_LOCAL_BIT) final buffer over a transfer-capable queue. Staging buffers matter most on dedicated GPUs without resizable BAR. maxMemoryAllocationCount can be as low as 4096, so a custom sub-allocator (or the vendored VulkanMemoryAllocator/VMA library) is recommended once many buffer objects exist rather than one VkDeviceMemory allocation per buffer.
